# Haphiz Ouarma

> AI and data engineer, and founder of Horizon's. Builds software for African
> markets and studies controlled experimentation, causal inference and machine
> learning. Based between Oujda, Morocco and Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso.

Canonical site: https://haphizouarma.com

## What he works on

- Online controlled experiments (A/B testing) at low traffic: variance
  reduction, CUPED, CUPAC, stratification, the Delta Method, choice of
  statistical test under skew.
- Machine learning and deep learning; representation learning and structured
  reasoning in large language models.
- Data and cloud engineering; system design for constrained environments —
  low-end devices, thin networks, mobile-money payment habits.

## Systems in production

- AfroBite (https://afrobite.app) — food delivery for Burkina Faso and Côte
  d'Ivoire. Four Flutter applications (customer, restaurant, courier, admin)
  over a serverless backend, with a BCEAO-compliant ring-fenced wallet, three
  mobile money providers, sub-second courier tracking and a vertical video
  feed. 56 cloud functions, 35+ collections. Built with a team.
- agriAI — agricultural intelligence for Burkinabè farmers, delivered inside
  WhatsApp: soil analysis, crop-disease diagnosis from photographs, and a
  seven-day forecast turned into irrigation instructions. Team of four, led.
- QCM Platform — assessment automation for instructors: AI question generation
  on Groq, instant marking, and score-based clustering that surfaces students
  at risk. Next.js, Spring Boot, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Firebase.

## Writing

- "From Statistical Foundations to Trustworthy Online Experimentation: A
  Practitioner's Guide to Sensitivity at Scale" (2026) — a survey of variance
  estimation with the Delta Method, variance reduction with CUPED and CUPAC,
  and the choice of statistical test.
  https://medium.com/@ouarmahaphiz02/from-statistical-foundations-to-modern-online-controlled-experiments-variance-estimation-variance-bf74ebdd8371

## Position

Africa should not only consume technology; it should invent, publish, build and
export its own. Horizon's is the vehicle for that: research, entrepreneurship
and education in one place, with Horizon's Academy training the engineers.
